simulation.py; they are NOT IAU 2015 nominal GM parameters or JPL masses.

Explicit own discrete ring approximation, sharing the normal body/force model.

points interact with every body, including one another; no masked EIH terms,

Conservative Newtonian N-body with ONE dynamical rigid Q2 figure.

SI; q=(w,x,y,z) body→inertial, S inertial. Point forces are computed once;
the figure correction, reaction and torque follow one common potential.
No prescribed axes, tides, EIH, contacts or figure–figure terms.

Exterior quadrupole gravity, with fixed or explicitly prescribed axes.

This is a controlled approximation, not coupled spin/orbit dynamics.
Every figure/point interaction includes the reaction on the figure's body.

Restricted optical orbit determination in ICRF/SSB, AU and TDB days.

The fitted target is a massless Newtonian particle. Prescribed background
ephemerides and measured observer positions are external inputs. They are not
the target's future trajectory. This module does not replace the closed N-body
simulation, nor infer physical accuracy in metres from angular residuals.
Project saved snapshots; rendering never changes the physical experiment.

Earth: precession plus the dominant 18.6-year nutation, without fitted frame bias.
